recipes.name: Miso Glazed Salmon
recipes.description: A delicious and flavorful dish featuring tender salmon with a savory miso glaze.
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C).
In a bowl, mix miso paste, soy sauce, honey, rice vinegar, ginger, and garlic.
Place salmon fillets on a baking sheet lined with foil.
Brush miso mixture over the salmon.
Bake for 12-15 minutes, or until salmon is cooked through.

recipes.name: Caprese Salad
recipes.description: A fresh and vibrant salad showcasing juicy tomatoes, creamy mozzarella, and fragrant basil.
instructions: Arrange tomato and mozzarella slices on a serving platter.
Tuck basil leaves in between tomato and mozzarella slices.
Drizzle balsamic glaze and olive oil over the salad.
Season with salt and pepper before serving.

recipes.name: Lemon Garlic Butter Shrimp Pasta
recipes.description: A delightful pasta dish featuring succulent shrimp tossed in a lemon garlic butter sauce.
ingredients: 1 lb large shrimp, peeled and deveined
instructions: Cook pasta according to package instructions, then drain and set aside.
In a large pan, melt butter over medium heat.
Add shrimp and garlic, cooking until shrimp turns pink.
Pour in chicken broth and lemon juice, simmer for a few minutes.
Toss cooked pasta in the shrimp mixture, season with salt and pepper.
Garnish with chopped parsley before serving.

recipes.name: Vegetarian Stuffed Bell Peppers
recipes.description: Colorful bell peppers stuffed with a flavorful mixture of quinoa, black beans, corn, and spices.
ingredients: 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed
Shredded cheese and chopped cilantro for topping
instructions: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C).
In a bowl, mix cooked quinoa, black beans, corn, salsa, cumin, chili powder, salt, and pepper.
Stuff the bell pepper halves with the quinoa mixture.
Place stuffed peppers in a baking dish, cover with foil, and bake for 25-30 minutes.
Remove foil, sprinkle shredded cheese on top, and bake for an additional 5 minutes until cheese melts.
Garnish with chopped cilantro before serving.
